manifesto.label: Manifesto
lines: I do not ship work that only looks good.
I carry the brand's character into digital.
I unite design, software, and technology in one system.
Every project is built to be distinct and outcome driven.

featured.blurb: For Wholesale Cabinet Creations we built a site that carries manufacturing quality online. Fast on mobile, SEO ready, with a CMS the team can run day to day.

Faster mobile paths to product and contact.
Content, media, and SEO in one panel.

items.title: WhatsApp Conversation Assistant
items.description: Talks to WhatsApp customers like you no need to watch your phone. Knows prices and services. Knows free hours and sends bookings there. Knows busy hours and books around them. Knows when a cancel frees a slot. Reminder 1 hour before to cut last minute cancels.
includes: Chat like you (with your prices and services)
Knows free hours, directs bookings there
Knows busy hours, avoids double booking
Opens the hour again after a cancel

items.title: Instagram DM Assistant
items.description: Same in Instagram DMs. Without watching your phone: knows prices and services, free hours, busy hours, and hours freed by cancels. Reminder 1 hour before.
includes: Answers on price, services, and FAQs
Books free hours, skips busy ones
Opens the hour again after a cancel

items.title: CRM Sales Panel
items.description: Works with the WhatsApp and Instagram assistants. Appointments, cancels, and customers in one panel. Which hours are free, who's coming when you check it there.
includes: Auto record when a booking is made
Hour opens again after a cancel
